propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a reply, causing quoted tool results or dependency-link records to be returned instead of the actual payload
schema-blind candidate selection in prompted structured-output extraction causes recurring defects that resurface after model swaps (e.g., Bedrock cutover changed trigger rate)
Bedrock provider-native structured output requires measured safety validation per model before use, currently protected by stale blanket thinking guard
A replayable raw-reply artifact on parse failure must be added as an opt-in capability for debugging prompt path failures
Bedrock SDK floor (botocore>=1.43) must be raised to accept Converse outputConfig client-side for native structured output support
The prompt-to-native output transition must ship sentinel directive and extraction atomically to prevent distribution drift
